verdict.rationale: The evidence shows WorkOS publishes an OpenAPI spec and static API reference pages, and one community comment praises how the docs look. Nothing documents an interactive API explorer or runnable, try-it-now examples. An OpenAPI file is a building block someone could use to build such an explorer, not the capability itself, so the verdict stays none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
